links.title: Claude Working Time
links.tooltip: How long Claude Code worked for each engineer, per repository and workday. That dashboard uses your browser's timezone where this one uses UTC, so a relative range such as Today covers your local day there

panels.description: Number of distinct repositories that prompts ran in. Prompts without a repository ('Unknown') are not counted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.repository_url) AS "Repositories"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})

panels.title: Repositories

panels.description: Repository with the most prompts, shown as its path, such as owner/repo. Prompts without a repository are ignored.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
    WHEN m.url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN m.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(m.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', '')
    -- CodeCommit URLs have no owner, only v1/repos/ before the repository name.
    WHEN m.url REGEXP '^https?://git-codecommit[.][^/]+[.]amazonaws[.]com/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(m.url, '^https?://[^/]+/v1/repos/', '')
    -- Azure DevOps puts _git/ between the project and the repository.
    ELSE REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(m.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', ''), '/_git/', '/')
  END AS "Most active repository"
FROM (
  SELECT p.repository_url AS url, COUNT(*) AS prompts
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.repository_url IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.repository_url
) m
ORDER BY m.prompts DESC, m.url
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Prompts Without a Repository

panels.description: One row per repository, engineer, model and permission mode, with prompts, their share of all prompts in the table, sessions, estimated cost in total and per prompt, and average input, output, cache read and cache write tokens per prompt. Skill Usage is the share of the row's prompts that used a skill, and Skills lists the skills used. Repository 'Unknown' means no origin remote was reported, Project is 'Unmapped' when no DevLake project you can access collects the repository, and Model 'N/A' means the prompt made no model request, such as a local slash command; click a repository to open it in a new tab.

targets.rawSql:
-- base is every prompt the panel counts.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.workspace_key, p.session_id, p.prompt_id, p.repository_url,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    -- Grouping on the raw columns keeps the sort keys narrow; the labels are applied once per row at the end.
    p.models_used, p.permission_mode,
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '') AS full_name,
    p.estimated_cost_usd, p.input_tokens, p.output_tokens, p.cache_read_tokens, p.cache_creation_tokens, p.used_skill
  FROM ai_prompts p
  -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
  -- another account with the same email.
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
), prompt_rows AS (
  -- A prompt row carries the prompt's metrics, and a skill row only a skill name, so one
  -- grouping gives both without joining skills to the metrics: the aggregates skip NULLs.
  SELECT repository_url, user, models_used, permission_mode, full_name, 1 AS prompt, session_id,
    estimated_cost_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, used_skill, NULL AS skill_name
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.repository_url, b.user, b.models_used, b.permission_mode, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, s.skill_name
  FROM base b
  JOIN ai_prompt_skills s ON s.workspace_key = b.workspace_key AND s.session_id = b.session_id AND s.prompt_id = b.prompt_id
), r AS (
  SELECT repository_url, user, models_used, permission_mode,
    MAX(full_name) AS full_name,
    COUNT(prompt) AS prompts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
    SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens,
    SUM(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens,
    AVG(used_skill) AS skill_share,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT skill_name ORDER BY skill_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS skills
  FROM prompt_rows
  GROUP BY repository_url, user, models_used, permission_mode
)
-- The hint lifts GROUP_CONCAT's 1024-character default for this query, so a repository in many
-- projects isn't cut off in Project.
SELECT /*+ SET_VAR(group_concat_max_len = 1048576) */ CASE
    WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', '')
    -- CodeCommit URLs have no owner, only v1/repos/ before the repository name.
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://git-codecommit[.][^/]+[.]amazonaws[.]com/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/v1/repos/', '')
    -- Azure DevOps puts _git/ between the project and the repository.
    ELSE REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://[^/]+/', ''), '/_git/', '/')
  END AS "Repository",
  CASE
    WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'GitHub'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'GitLab'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'Bitbucket'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://(dev[.]azure[.]com|[^/]+[.]visualstudio[.]com)/' THEN 'Azure DevOps'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://git-codecommit[.][^/]+[.]amazonaws[.]com/' THEN 'AWS CodeCommit'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://source[.]developers[.]google[.]com/' THEN 'Google Cloud Source'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?codeberg[.]org/' THEN 'Codeberg'
    WHEN r.repository_url REGEXP '^https?://git[.]sr[.]ht/' THEN 'SourceHut'
    -- Any other host, such as a self-hosted Gitea, is shown by its host name.
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.repository_url, '^https?://([^/]+).*$', '$1')
  END AS "Repo Source",
  CASE WHEN r.repository_url IS NULL THEN 'No repository' ELSE COALESCE(dl.projects, 'Unmapped') END AS "Project",
  COALESCE(r.full_name, r.user) AS "Engineer",
  CASE WHEN r.models_used = '' THEN 'N/A' ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') END AS "Model",
  CASE r.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE r.permission_mode END AS "Mode",
  r.prompts AS "Prompts",
  r.prompts / SUM(r.prompts) OVER () AS "Share",
  r.sessions AS "Sessions",
  r.cost AS "Cost",
  r.cost / r.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  r.input_tokens / r.prompts AS "Input Tokens per Prompt",
  r.output_tokens / r.prompts AS "Output Tokens per Prompt",
  r.cache_read_tokens / r.prompts AS "Cache Read Tokens per Prompt",
  r.cache_creation_tokens / r.prompts AS "Cache Write Tokens per Prompt",
  r.skill_share AS "Skill Usage",
  COALESCE(r.skills, '') AS "Skills",
  -- repository_link is empty for prompts without a repository, so their Repository cell has no link.
  COALESCE(r.repository_url, '') AS repository_link
FROM r
LEFT JOIN (
  -- repository_url drops one trailing / and then one .git suffix, and is lowercased, so normalize
  -- repos.url the same way.
  SELECT LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(rp.url, '/$', ''), '[.]git$', '')) AS url,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pm.project_name ORDER BY pm.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS projects
  FROM repos rp
  -- Only projects the viewer can access, so a repository shared with another project doesn't
  -- reveal its name.
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rp.id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
    AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_p.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_p WHERE upm_p.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(rp.url, '/$', ''), '[.]git$', ''))
) dl ON dl.url = r.repository_url
ORDER BY r.repository_url IS NULL, 2, 1, 4, r.prompts DESC

panels.title: Prompt Usage by Repository

panels.description: Total input, output, cache read and cache write tokens for each repository and engineer; a repository's rows add up to its bar in Token Usage by Repository on the Claude Prompts dashboard. Repository 'Unknown' means no origin remote was reported, and Project is 'Unmapped' when no DevLake project you can access collects the repository. Click a repository to open it in a new tab.

targets.rawSql:
-- base sums every prompt the panel counts per repository URL and user; the labels are applied once per row.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.repository_url AS url,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
    -- another account with the same email.
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name,
    SUM(p.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(p.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    SUM(p.cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens,
    SUM(p.cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY p.repository_url, 2
)
SELECT CASE
    WHEN b.url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(b.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', '')
    -- CodeCommit URLs have no owner, only v1/repos/ before the repository name.
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://git-codecommit[.][^/]+[.]amazonaws[.]com/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(b.url, '^https?://[^/]+/v1/repos/', '')
    -- Azure DevOps puts _git/ between the project and the repository.
    ELSE REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(b.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', ''), '/_git/', '/')
  END AS "Repository",
  CASE
    WHEN b.url IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'GitHub'
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'GitLab'
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN 'Bitbucket'
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://(dev[.]azure[.]com|[^/]+[.]visualstudio[.]com)/' THEN 'Azure DevOps'
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://git-codecommit[.][^/]+[.]amazonaws[.]com/' THEN 'AWS CodeCommit'
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://source[.]developers[.]google[.]com/' THEN 'Google Cloud Source'
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?codeberg[.]org/' THEN 'Codeberg'
    WHEN b.url REGEXP '^https?://git[.]sr[.]ht/' THEN 'SourceHut'
    -- Any other host, such as a self-hosted Gitea, is shown by its host name.
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(b.url, '^https?://([^/]+).*$', '$1')
  END AS "Repo Source",
  CASE WHEN b.url IS NULL THEN 'No repository' ELSE COALESCE(dl.projects, 'Unmapped') END AS "Project",
  COALESCE(b.full_name, b.user) AS "Engineer",
  b.input_tokens AS "Input",
  b.output_tokens AS "Output",
  b.cache_read_tokens AS "Cache read",
  b.cache_creation_tokens AS "Cache write",
  -- repository_link is empty for prompts without a repository, so their Repository cell has no link.
  COALESCE(b.url, '') AS repository_link
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN (
  -- repository_url drops one trailing / and then one .git suffix, and is lowercased, so normalize
  -- repos.url the same way.
  SELECT LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(rp.url, '/$', ''), '[.]git$', '')) AS url,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pm.project_name ORDER BY pm.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS projects
  FROM repos rp
  -- Only projects the viewer can access, so a repository shared with another project doesn't
  -- reveal its name.
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rp.id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
    AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_p.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_p WHERE upm_p.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(rp.url, '/$', ''), '[.]git$', ''))
) dl ON dl.url = b.url
ORDER BY b.url IS NULL, 2, 1, b.input_tokens + b.output_tokens + b.cache_read_tokens + b.cache_creation_tokens DESC

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;

-- The label is the person's full name from their DevLake account, falling back to the email; the value stays the
-- email (or user key) that every panel filters on.
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS __text, u.user AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
) u

list.definition:
-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;

list.query:
-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in, labelled as on Token Usage by Repository.
-- 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real repository_url is always an
-- https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?github[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GH: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?gitlab[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'GL: ')
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://(www[.])?bitbucket[.]org/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/', 'BB: ')
    -- Bitbucket Server clone URLs carry an scm/ prefix that the SSH remote of the same repository lacks.
    WHEN r.url REGEXP '^https?://([^/]*[.])?bitbucket[^/.]*[.][^/]+/' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://[^/]+/(scm/)?', 'BB: ')
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '')
  END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND cp_g.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
